name: St Willibrord, Clayton
note: Now part of a new parish of Holy Spirit (22.09.2017)

boundary.description: From the point where Bank Street crosses River Medlock, E along River Medlock to the point where it crosses Edge Lane then by a bee-line along W boundary of Sunnybank Park and across School Play Fields to Sunny Bank Road. Then W along Manchester Road, S along Buxton Lane, to Ashton Canal. E by the canal to and W along Ashton New Road, then N by Bank Street and along footpath to the bridge on River Medlock. W by the River Medlock to the point where it crosses Bank Street.
